content: {"praised":["Tim Burton’s stylish, dark tone enhances the superhero vibe.","Michael Keaton delivers a definitive, compelling performance.","Villains are complex, with deeper backstories.","The film balances action and character development.","Visuals and music support the gritty atmosphere."],"criticized":["Story focuses too much on Penguin and Catwoman.","Catwoman’s role feels overrated and underdeveloped.","The plot is overly centered on Penguin’s sadness.","Pacing feels uneven, with some scenes dragging.","Overall narrative lacks cohesion and depth."]}
